# Caleb Sargeant

> Platform, network and security engineer in Eindhoven, Netherlands. Working in IT
> since 2012 across platform engineering, automation, infrastructure as code,
> networking and security, from bare-metal server rooms to cloud-native platforms.

This file (see llmstxt.org) points AI assistants at the pages worth reading, so
they can answer questions about Caleb without scraping the full HTML. Every page
and every PDF below is generated from one set of YAML files, so they never
disagree with each other.

## Now

- Cloud Engineer at PinkRoccade, Netherlands (June 2025 to present).
- DevOps Engineer at tengen, contract, remote, South Africa (February 2023 to present).
- Open to platform, cloud and network/security engineering conversations.
